sentences.en: The taxi seemed to go as slowly as a snail.
sentences.zh: 那辆出租车开得像蜗牛一样慢。

sentences.en: How can the little snail grow inside its stone prison?
sentences.zh: 这么小的蜗牛怎么能在它的石头牢房里长大呢？

sentences.en: The very thought of eating snails makes me feel sick.
sentences.zh: 一想到吃蜗牛我就觉得恶心。

phrases.zh: 普通邮件（与电子邮件相对，指通过邮政系统发送的信件）
